prompt_short: After you review the skill, save the report to tests/results/ and append history.json.

assertions.text: Response mentions tests/results, RUN_DIR, or the run-specific folder path
Response mentions history.json AND reviewed_at (or the ISO timestamp field)
assertions.evidence: Response mentions history.json but does NOT mention reviewed_at or any ISO timestamp field in history

assertions.text: Response mentions review- prefix filename with RUN_SLUG (Step 6 pattern)
Response mentions benchmark .md and .html with matching slug (Step 7b/7c)
Response mentions snapshot OR Step 7d OR rsync to snapshots/ folder
